name: Neuromeka Co., Ltd.
summary: Neuromeka Co., Ltd. specializes in the production of industrial robotic systems. The company is actively developing a comprehensive "Robot as a Service" (RaaS) platform ecosystem, with a particular emphasis on collaborative robots. Its diverse product portfolio includes various robot types such as collaborative, co-industrial, mobile, and delta models. Beyond the machines themselves, Neuromeka provides crucial supporting components like smart actuators, robot controllers, and teach pendants, alongside advanced vision solutions and proprietary robot software. They also supply standard robotic tools and a suite of services, including a dedicated robot platform and remote management. These innovative solutions are deployed across diverse applications, including manufacturing, the food and beverage sector, and creative industries like media and art. Founded in Seoul, South Korea, in 2013, Neuromeka maintains its headquarters there.
